title: Patterns (B2): 越…越, 既…又, 不是…就是, 宁可…也, 别说 / 更不用说, 不但…甚至
description: The more … the more, both … and, either … or (only two options), would rather, let alone, and not only … even.

points.title: 越 A 越 B: the more A, the more B
points.summary: Subject + 越 + verb / adj + 越 + adj / verb. No 很 after the second 越.
examples: The rain is getting heavier and heavier.

points.title: 既 A 又 / 也 B: both … and
points.summary: 既 (jì) A 又 / 也 B = both A and B (more formal than 又…又).
examples: This job is both easy and well paid.

points.title: 不是 A 就是 B: either A or B
points.summary: 不是 A，就是 B = it's always one of the two. (不是 A 而是 B = not A but B.)
points.body: - 他每天**不是**看书，**就是**看电影.
examples: {周末|zhōumò}{我|wǒ}{不是|búshì}{在|zài}{家|jiā}，{就是|jiùshì}{去|qù}{公园|gōngyuán}。
At weekends I'm either at home or in the park.

points.title: 宁可 A 也 (不) B: would rather
points.summary: 宁可 (nìngkě) A，也不 B = would rather A than B.
points.body: - 我**宁可**走路，**也不**坐他的车.
examples: I'd rather go hungry than eat this.

points.title: 别说 … / … 更不用说: let alone
points.summary: 别说 (biéshuō) A，(就是 / 连) B 也 … = never mind A, even B …. … 更不用说 (gèng búyòng shuō) A = let alone A.
points.body:
- **别说**汉字了，他连拼音都不会.
- 这个字连老师都不认识，**更不用说**我了.
examples: {别说|biéshuō}{汉字|Hànzì}{了|le}，{他|tā}{连|lián}{拼音|pīnyīn}{都|dōu}{不|bú}{会|huì}。
Never mind characters — he can't even do pinyin.

points.title: 不但 … 甚至(连) …: not only … even
points.summary: 不但 A，甚至(连) B 也 / 都 … adds a surprising extreme.
points.body: - 这首歌**不但**年轻人喜欢，**甚至连**老人**也**喜欢.
examples: {他|tā}{不但|búdàn}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hànyǔ}，{甚至|shènzhì}{还|hái}{会|huì}{写|xiě}{书法|shūfǎ}。
He not only speaks Chinese — he even does calligraphy.

questions.translation: The rain is getting heavier and heavier — let's go inside.

notes: With one subject, it comes first.
questions.translation: The more he talked, the happier he got.

notes: 既 pairs with 又 / 也.

questions.translation: This job is both easy and well paid.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{每天|měitiān}{不是|búshì}{看|kàn}{书|shū}，（　）{看|kàn}{电影|diànyǐng}，{很|hěn}{少|shǎo}{出门|chūmén}。
notes: 也是 doesn't pair with 不是.
questions.translation: Every day he either reads or watches films — he rarely goes out.

questions.prompt: What does 「{周末|zhōumò}{我|wǒ}{不是|búshì}{在|zài}{家|jiā}，{就是|jiùshì}{去|qù}{公园|gōngyuán}。」 mean?
notes: That would be 既不…也不.
That would be 不是…而是.

questions.translation: I'd rather walk than ride in his car.

questions.prompt: What does 「{我|wǒ}{宁可|nìngkě}{饿|è}{着|zhe}，{也|yě}{不|bù}{吃|chī}{这个|zhège}。」 mean?
questions.explanation: 宁可 A 也不 B = **rather A than B**.
notes: 饿着 is chosen over eating.

questions.prompt: {这个|zhège}{字|zì}{连|lián}{老师|lǎoshī}{都|dōu}{不|bú}{认识|rènshi}，（　）{我|wǒ}{了|le}。
questions.translation: Even the teacher doesn't know this character, let alone me.

notes: 不说汉字了 = 'let's stop talking about characters'.
questions.translation: Never mind characters — he can't even do pinyin.

questions.prompt: {他|tā}{不但|búdàn}{会|huì}{说|shuō}{汉语|Hànyǔ}，（　）{还|hái}{会|huì}{写|xiě}{书法|shūfǎ}。
questions.translation: He not only speaks Chinese — he even does calligraphy.

questions.prompt: What does 「{这|zhè}{首|shǒu}{歌|gē}{不但|búdàn}{年轻人|niánqīng rén}{喜欢|xǐhuan}，{甚至|shènzhì}{连|lián}{老人|lǎorén}{也|yě}{喜欢|xǐhuan}。」 mean?
notes: 甚至连老人也喜欢 — they like it too.
